# Seed data fixtures

- `small/`: the small profile, seed 1234, generated by `make seed-small`.
  Committed so unit tests and CI can use realistic data without generating
  it. Do not edit by hand; the determinism test fails unless it is exactly
  what the generator produces.
- `schema/`: JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) for every file of a dataset:
  `<file path with / replaced by .>.schema.json`, with shared definitions in
  `common.schema.json`. The small dataset is validated against them in
  `tools/seed/internal/generate/oracle_test.go`.

The full description is in [docs/seed-data.md](../../docs/seed-data.md):
layout, formats, how notes are built through `libs/crdt`, the definition of
every piece of ground truth, and the contract service loaders follow.

## Profiles

Users, workspaces and notes are exact; blocks are a target met within ±15%.

| Profile | Workspaces | Users | Notes | Blocks (target) | Committed | How to get it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | 3 | 25 | 300 | 4,000 | yes, `small/` | `make seed-small` |
| medium | 10 | 200 | 8,000 | 150,000 | no | `make seed PROFILE=medium` |
| large | 50 | 2,000 | 100,000 | 2,000,000 | no | `make seed PROFILE=large` |
| stress | 4 | 120 | 150,068 | 151,000 | no | `make seed PROFILE=stress` |
